[b]The Solar Falcon[/b]

For the past three years the builders at Corland Eerian Shipyards had been working on a specialised gift to the government to celebrate 100 years of government exclusive contracts, the gift was to be the centerpiece of a special celebration of Thývens advancement in technology over the past century and those who had made it possible. However, these plans were derailed upon the creation of the Empire, which saw the shipyards immediately shift their idea towards a more Imperial Ideal seeking to impress the Emperors and those who doubted the Empire. 

As a result, the ship, The Solar Falcon, would be revealed in private plans to the Emperor of Elesyr-Shamat, the ship would be a 1,034 foot long ocean liner, which would act as a floating palace for the government and the Emperors, it would be made from the already pre-built hull of another ocean liner of which had been seized by creditors following the collapse of the company that had commissioned it. Extravagant interiors and living quarters would be heavily emphasized, as size and luxury were the goal. The ship would be painted white and gold, and the funnels would have the colors of the national flag upon it. Three dining rooms would be onboard, along with a ballroom, cinema, theater, three pools, and various other amenities. Offices and other logistical spaces would be made in order to permit it to be a functioning government office. The ship would ultimately be able to hold 2,000 people with room for 100 or so more should some of the offices be converted to rooms. The Emperor would immediately approve of the plan, offering his own budget from the coffers of the royal trust to fund the ships refitting. In the times that the ship was not being actively under use by the Emperors, it would be owned by the Elesyr Line as a specialised and unique cruise experience.

Thus, with a set date of launch being Febuary 2027, the Corland Eerian shipyards would begin refitting work on the former SS Mendhaven in order to convert it into the IMS Solar Falcon, with a formal press release and plans being released soon thereafter the funding was approved. 

The media would immediately dub the ship [i]The Floating Cake[/i] and [i]A Gift Fit for Imperial Ambitions[/i]. Indeed fiscal conservatives in the government would balk at the idea of the government even possessing such a large ship for the emperors to own, it was unheard of for a monarch anywhere to own not a yacht, but an ocean liner. However, with the Emperor himself funding the project from his own investments, the government itself had little qualms, though the general populace questioned the extravagance of the affair.

[b]HORGINGTONIA (Lamandican Petoleum Colony? Why?)[/b]

In terms of oil, we have no oil.

Lamandica's two largest oil companies, RELCO and Cieliox, are on the verge of being shut down. Throughout Lamandica's history, the nation has had very few oil resources, and the ones that were present have since dried up. Prices for a liter of gas in Lamandica have hit an all-time high of [u]eleven[/u] Pelops. With growing demand for very limited gas resources, Prime Minister Calieno-Ruiz has called an emergency meeting and announced a solution: Lamandica's first-ever colony.

This colony, which will be called Horgingtonia (or Lamandican Petroleum Colony), will be established just to the north of [nation]Hatorre[/nation] in Southwestern Vespuria. Its capital will be Puerto Encarnacion, with the rest of the province being mainly refineries and onshore drilling facilities. This area has been chosen due to its plentiful oil resources, as well as being the closest available land with oil to Lamandica. This colony is expected to be quite wealthy and full of prospecting contractors, claims Calieno-Ruiz. This will be the first time under the governance of Calieno-Ruiz that Lamandica will seek to expand.

[b]The Ashes | Erene2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

January 1st, Palace of the Republic, Vëlvetel

It's a cloudy, snowy, but otherwise quiet night in the City of Vëlvetel, it's been quiet since the revolution, really. The city's 150,000 Residents or so were evacuated to other cities due to the large-scale destruction, or otherwise taken away to prison camps for collaboration with the old royalist regime, leaving nothing but the silent winds to sweep its once vibrant city. But recently, starting November with the reconstruction, it's gotten alot louder.

"...Huh"

Muller's son. Noah Muller says, looking upon the city that he had frequently visited with his father when he was still Mayor of Teinesbur before the war. He looked at the still incomplete palace of the republic, which had almost completely consumed the grounds of the old royalist palace; it was mostly still a concrete husk; none of the glass, facades, or anything really had been installed yet, and there was still tons of scaffolding and even an entire crane still surrounding the building. He then looked behind him towards the old parliment building, construction on the Revolutionary Tribunal hadn't actually started yet, all that was there was an empty lot, then in to the left, the reflecting pool had mostly been kept the way it was before the war, it was going to be surrounded by a wall of names of revolutionaries who died during the revolution at some point.

He couldn't remember this city, just this time, 3 years ago he had been here with Annelien and Maxmallian, joking about something he couldn't remember. That would be the last time the three ever spoke; his father had defected a month later to the revolution and rose to become one of its primary leaders. His mayoral ship over his Téiernsbuer and his active harboring and quiet support of revolutionary elements had been his saving grace. Ever now and then, he would look back at the palace of the republic, and the old royal palace would flash into view in his head as a fuzzy memory; some parts of the royalist palace would just be blurred beyond recognition, like the towers that surrounded the palace, and then some areas, like its garden, would be more memorable. When he visited the palace with his father, he especially during the dinners that the Royal Family hosted with various members of the government. That garden is usually where he would converse with Maxmailan, the two went to the same school before the war.

By this time next year, most of the city would probably be rebuilt, and he probably wouldn't be able to even remember what it looked like before. It's...a weird feeling to see the country you where born in torn apart and then rebuilt in a way that is completely unrecognizable . He knows he's probably supposed to get back to the train station to head back to Téiernsbuer. But he decides to stay a bit longer to walk around the city, one last time. While he does so, he grabs a cigarette and his lighter, and closes his eyes.

[b]Feel the ash on your shoulders.
Close your eyes.
and be at peace...[/b]
